author: Astrokillah
text:
Just an observation that I would like to share. I have been 'trying
hard' to prove that FL, and ONLY FL, is the answer to unlock the secret
of price movement. But I have failed miserably.

In the diagram above, A, B, C, D are all FLs visibled on H1 timeframe. I wanted to believe that:

1) We should only pay attention to FLs, especially the boundaries of
FLs. When an FL is engulfed, we are promised that price would reach the
next FL in the direction of the engulf.

2) A reaction to an FL is not as important as the FL itself, for example, the peak at Point 1, is a reaction to B.

Well, I was wrong, I have noticed in several instances that after price
engulfed D, it did not get to C, it bounced to the pip at Point 2,
reversed and broke through A. And there's no kink to be found at that
level, not even on M1, there's no visible kink (perhaps we need to go
down to tick chart to see that?)

That makes it very difficult in a way, because the general consensus in the FOREX world is that HTF elements trounces LTF.

So HTF SD zone is stronger than LTF SD zones, HTF SR is stronger than LTF SR.

But in the example I am giving here, it doesn't seem to be the case?

author: ViTaLDRuG
text:
Hi AK,

I feel you.. I had the same doubts.. But as you said.. B is the
important one.. not the high at "1". But when "D" FL is made, B is no
longer valid. So for a valid short entry in your above example, you will
 have to have an engulf which haven't any of the possible target in the
same scale. For example, The high at "1" (although it is not important,
still it is a high, we have to avoid all possible targets), the low end
of the FL B, which is a LS, or a very old very High TF key level. You
said sometimes you see that, what you see as engulf is reaction to a SR
filp (e.g. as you have shown at "1"). But, most of the time it is not
actually a reaction to that SR flip (e.g. "1" in your image). It is a
higher time frame key level. Please extend your dotted line ("2" to "1")
 further to left in HTF. You will see this. This is just my experience.
To some people, my case will be valid, but for some mine will not!. I
will post an example, if I find any.

Thanks,

author: HCDE
text:
Hi AK,

To my opinion, FL (or S/R kinks) are important, but they are one piece
of the puzzle. Remember, in his vids, IF tells us to watch PA at four
places: S/R Kinks, LS, PCP, break into CP. It means that all of these
can bounce price (with or without PA).

If you see what looks like arbitrary PA, it doensn't necessarilly means
that price is reacting to LTF over HTF. It could also mean that there is
 Something 'HTF' that you haven't on your chart. FXTOP is your friend
(or if he isn't, then make it a friend )

Thanks for all your posts in your journal by the way, i love the way you
 think and describe your things, very clear (and i know how much being
Crystal clear after a day of trading isn't easy )

Hugo

times to digest. So that's what I'm going to do for the next few days.

Trading wise, my December account was doing quite ok, I got to +12%
after just 4 days of trading in December (by 5 December), then as I was
travelling, I could not baby-seat several pending orders that got
triggered. Two of them actually brought me huge profit at one stage but
then price quickly reversed and caused some DD on the account, I had to
do a few crazy thing to salvage the DD. I learned a few things from a
trading buddy (I called him Master Scalper): He normally trades when
there's no RED news, and he noticed that in the absence of red news,
price is just going to do yo-yo, or move like ping-pong ball, up and
down, up and down. So for example, if he shorted from one supply level,
and this level fails to hold, he wouldn't get panicked, he would add a
second short position when he sees price engulf south after it has
reached the next supply level higher up. So then, price only have to
drop half way between his two entries for him to get out of the trades
in positive overall. I did this in one trade, and it worked, but the
account statement is showing 1.77% drawdown because one of the trades
was closed in negative.
